## Changes
- **Relic valuation now uses the game's own formulas.** A relic grants levels of the ancient its bonus
  belongs to (wiki: Relics, post-0.25b), so each relic's effect is
  `ancientBonus(level + relicLevels)` versus `ancientBonus(level)` — the same formula table the app
  already uses for ancients (Siyalatas' idle curve, Atman/Chronos/Vaagur diminishing returns, …).
  No invented coefficients remain; the only judgement left is the visible weighting between DPS, gold,
  souls and utility.
- Table shows those four relative gains per relic, so the score can be checked against them.
